prompt: When a session is checkpointed but has no transcript content, the recorded session metadata still points at transcript and content-hash files that were never written to disk. Anything that later follows those recorded paths hits missing files. Make sure a session with no transcript does not leave behind references to files that don't exist. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: checkpoint session summary transcript path recording
empty transcript handling during checkpoint write
content hash file written for session
_subject: fix: don't record phantom transcript paths for empty transcripts
